messages.author: e1e639eeab121011
messages.subject: color group bug in 1.0.0
parts:
Hi I am running into issues with ggplot after I upgraded to R 3.1.0

I can't even run the example code on ggplot2 website. 

> mry <- do.call(rbind, by(movies, round(movies$rating), function(df) {
+   nums <- tapply(df$length, df$year, length)
+   data.frame(rating=round(df$rating[1]), year = as.numeric(names(nums)), number=as.vector(nums))
+ }))

> p <- ggplot(mry, aes(x=year, y=number, group=rating))
> p + geom_line()
> p <- ggplot(mry, aes(x=year, y=number, group=rating))
> p + geom_line()
> p + geom_line(aes(colour = rating))
Error in laply(l, cond) : .fun is not a function.

I thought it might be an issue with plyr which was also upgraded but all other functions seems to work just fine.

 Please ignore.
